name: Virar
intro: A growing residential destination with strong Western Line connectivity, everyday conveniences, and expanding infrastructure. Virar offers the space to live better, with the city still within reach.

seo.title: Flats near Virar Station
seo.description: MahaRERA-registered 1 BHK homes on the Virar–Nalasopara link road by Deep Group, 6 minutes from Virar station.

name: Nallasopara
intro: Nallasopara has been part of Deep Group’s story for over two decades. From its established neighbourhoods in the East to the growing communities in the West, our projects have grown alongside the people and the place we have called home for years.

seo.title: Flats near Nallasopara Station
seo.description: 1 & 2 BHK homes a short walk from Nallasopara station by Deep Group: Deep Crown, Deep Emerald and Deep Landmark.

name: Vasai Road
intro: Vasai is a blend of history and a growing residential landscape. With the heritage of Vasai Fort and its coastal roots, Deep Group has been a part of this growth with projects across Vasai’s established residential communities.

seo.title: Flats in Vasai East near Vasai Road Station
seo.description: 1 & 2 BHK homes in Evershine City and Yashwant Smart City, Vasai East, by Deep Group.

name: Mira Road
intro: Mira Road has turned into a key residential and commercial corridor between Mumbai and Thane. With strong rail and road connectivity, Deep Group found it the best location to establish an Industrial Hub.

seo.title: Industrial Galas & Plots on NH 48 near Mira Road
seo.description: Sky Industrial Hub by Deep Group: a 4.5-acre industrial development on NH 48 beside Hotel Fountain.
